title: Cinderworks — complete original offline Floor One visual study

arrival.name: The Descent
arrival.story: The stair mouth narrows into a supported service tunnel. A warning bell and supply route lead toward safety.

sanctuary.name: Bellkeeper Sanctuary
sanctuary.story: A worn bell court, repaired masonry, benches and warm lanterns make a recognizable place of refuge. The workshop flues are visible through its northern threshold.

workshop.name: The Working Court
workshop.story: Working benches face an annealing wall. Stock, carts and a paired rail line explain the flow from ore to finished parts.

waterworks.name: The Lock and Reservoir
waterworks.story: The open reservoir feeds a controlled runoff channel. Pumps, raised service gates and two crossings create an exploration loop between banks.

quarry.name: The Fracture Gallery
quarry.story: A broken rock face, loaded tubs and a rail curve expose the resource source. The lower service route rejoins the slag channel.

slag.name: Black Runoff
slag.story: Cooled slag, a damaged service bay and the second sluice make the transition toward danger visible. A narrow inspection route follows the water.

foundry.name: The Last Casting
foundry.story: A broad entry opens toward a raised casting ring and an original sluice-crowned creature. Retorts, cradled vessels and return pipes terminate the industrial sequence.
